translation.canonical_title: Violence against women is already far too heavy a task to add other forms of violence

translation.summary: If feminist groups do not address the issue, it is not so much out of disinterest as because violence against women is more various and more frequent and already constitutes a very heavy task. Therefore, instead of reproaching them, it would be more intelligent to create specifically dedicated groups.
